segments.name: power program
segments.description: Generates, transmits and sells electricity throughout the Tennessee Valley, mainly to LPCs and directly served customers.
segments.evidence: TVA operates as a single reportable segment that includes the generation, transmission, and sale of electricity throughout the Tennessee Valley.

revenueModel.text: Electricity buyers, mainly LPCs and directly served customers, pay for wholesale electricity sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is primarily derived from wholesale electricity sales to LPCs and directly served customers.
